rationale: The plan matches the reference closely: one DESeq2 model (~condition, control as reference) fitted on all twelve samples, an LRT against ~1 for the any-difference question, two named Wald contrasts against control from the same fit, a justified >=10-in->=4-samples filter, median-of-ratios inside the model, and BH at 0.05 within each contrast. Shrinkage is present, but the claim that apeglm cannot be used is incorrect (both contrasts are model coefficients with control as reference), and Step 5 ambiguously describes the LRT table as carrying an ashr-shrunken log2FC, edging toward the LRT-p-next-to-pairwise-FC confusion the reference warns against. QC is thorough but only promises to flag outliers without stating a handling policy. GSEA was not requested; it is nonetheless well specified (Wald-statistic ranking, Hallmark v2026.1, 15-500 window, per-contrast lists), though the Reactome version is left as 'current'. The report is complete on method, versions, thresholds, and counts, with the tximport caveat stated, but does not call out the small-replicate power limitation.
